record: PRB-004 .. PRB-009 — real-browser probe of the live viewer page (display and orientation)
how: real ViewerApp (Vite dev server) in headless Microsoft Edge with real WebGL (SwiftShader); every backend request answered by DevTools interception with a synthetic 40x48x36 LAS study (no patient data, no network): head 90-129, marker A (250, rows 14-18, columns 36-42, labelled by the lesion mask, whose header carries an MRI window -15.5/189.2) and marker B (180, rows 27-31, columns 8-12); slice index 17 set in every run; positions measured from the rendered pixels relative to the drawn head (u: 0 left .. 1 right, v: 0 top .. 1 bottom); page text and buttons hidden during each capture. Screenshots were produced next to each result (not committed).
